data_scope: supply only an explicitly authorised isolated bucket and prefix
generation_access: provision current and candidate generation ranges before pausing; preserve ingress/message/sync ownership and immutable control decision rights
compute_access: only scoped input GET/candidate PUT signatures; no COS role access; service control queries use per-attempt capability and instance identity
retirement: maintainer only; deny old-role writes at COS, verify 403 with still-valid old credentials, wait all issued candidate grants to expire, then collect the immutable manifest
automatic_maintenance: disabled until isolated validation; CALORIE_MAINTENANCE_VALIDATED=isolated-v2 is an operational gate, not evidence of a passed test
